cli.help.probe:
Usage: {command} probe [--as <role>]... [--json]

Checks a running LOCAL or DEMO instance, GET and HEAD only: security headers, cookies, CORS and version disclosure on "/" and on one API route; the access control of every GET route of facts/api.json against its auth (facts --source api), for anonymous and every --as role (its session saved by connect --as <role>). Writes facts/probe.json. Refused (exit code 2) outside local or demo (capture.target); never overridden. Unreachable instance: exit code 3.

Options
  --as <role>              repeatable: also checks as this role (its session: {work}/session-<role>.json)
cli.probe.notLocal: probe only checks a LOCAL or DEMO instance
cli.probe.notLocal.help: set capture.target to "local" or "demo" (app.url: {url}), or point app.url to a loopback address
cli.probe.publicData: {method} {route}: returns data with an email field to an anonymous caller

cli.probe.skipped.one: {n} route skipped (a path parameter is missing from review.params)
cli.probe.skipped.other: {n} routes skipped (a path parameter is missing from review.params)

cli.probe.unprotected: {method} {route}: answers an anonymous caller without being protected
